prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: fine pale beach sand with gentle wind ripples, tiny shells and pebbles. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a square seamless tileable pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map, pale fine beach sand, gently curved low-contrast wind ripples and very small scattered shells and pebbles, evenly distributed without any focal point. Fill edge to edge with sand only; exact matching continuous texture at left/right and top/bottom borders, no border or frame. Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG HD pixel art with deliberately hand-placed clean pixel clusters of 3–10 art pixels, consistent crisp square pixel grid across the whole image (roughly 256 x 256 art pixels, upscale each art pixel uniformly ~7–8 screen pixels). No antialiasing, blur, soft brush, photographic texture, random noise or checkerboard dithering. Rich earthy restrained 4–6 shades per material, hue-shifted sand shadows slightly more saturated muted purple-red, highlights warm cream-yellow. Orthographic directly top-down classic RPG map ground surface. Soft neutral even illumination upper left, clean base colors. No cast shadows, darkness, glow, lighting pools, vignette, objects, characters, plants, text, or large distinguishing features.
